title: Template: choose the tests that catch the bug

config.prompt: This BFS has a bug. Choose every test case it fails: each one is a graph, a start vertex and the order a correct BFS visits it in.

solution.explanation: Correct. The bug only shows when a vertex has two or more new neighbours, because then pop takes the wrong one first.

feedback.fork: A has two neighbours, so pop takes C before B: the faulty version visits A, C, B and fails this test.
feedback.line: Each vertex has only one new neighbour, so the queue never holds two vertices: the faulty version passes this test.
feedback.two-levels: A has two neighbours, so pop takes C before B: the faulty version visits A, C, B, D and fails this test.
feedback.two-islands: Each vertex has only one new neighbour, so the queue never holds two vertices: the faulty version passes this test.

hints.body: Which line takes a vertex out of the queue? Does it take the oldest one?
pop takes the newest vertex. That only matters when the queue holds two or more vertices.
Look for a start vertex with two neighbours.
Answer: fork and two-levels. In both, A has two neighbours, so pop visits C before B. In line and two-islands the queue never holds two vertices, so the faulty version passes.
